description: This file defines the PHPMailer class used for sending emails via SMTP, sendmail, or PHP mail(). It includes functionalities for composing emails, handling attachments, headers, and encoding, as well as managing SMTP connections.

classes.name: PHPMailer
classes.description: A class providing comprehensive email sending capabilities, including SMTP, sendmail, and PHP mail(), with support for attachments, encoding, headers, and error handling.

methods.name: IsHTML
methods.description: Sets the ContentType of the email to 'text/html' or 'text/plain'.

methods.name: IsSMTP
methods.description: Configures the mailer to use SMTP.

methods.name: IsMail
methods.description: Configures the mailer to use PHP mail().

methods.name: AddAddress
methods.description: Adds a recipient to the To list.

methods.name: AddCC
methods.description: Adds a recipient to the Cc list.

methods.name: AddBCC
methods.description: Adds a recipient to the Bcc list.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Creates and sends the email message, choosing the appropriate sending method based on configuration.

methods.name: AddAttachment
methods.description: Adds a file attachment from filesystem.

methods.name: AddStringAttachment
methods.description: Adds an attachment from a string or binary data.

methods.name: AddEmbeddedImage
methods.description: Embeds an inline image within the email content.
